messages:
June (PM): Quick: Prospect asks for BYOK + 5yr audit retention + auditor-ready export. Need minimal acceptance criteria for sprint planning.

Pri (Sales): High priority deal. They want export API + predictable storage fee.

Marco (Security): Must include integrity proof (file hashes or Merkle) + signed manifest. If CMEK used, keep wrapped DEKs across rotations.

Li (Eng): MVP plan: tenant CMEK config, retention tiers (90d/2y/5y), daily compressed chunks, export job that bundles logs+manifest+signature. Exports for TBs take hours.

Avery (Legal): Exports need chain-of-custody (requester, approver, hashes, signer id, timestamp). 5 business days SLA ok. Also require legal-hold pinning flow.

June (PM): Action items: Li -> cost + prototype export runner (EOW); Marco -> security sketch for wrapped DEKs + signing (EOW); Avery -> SLA wording + artifact checklist (Tue). We'll review next week. :thumbsup:
